checked_claims.source: matching-rulebook.pdf pp.18,21–23
checked_claims.detail: Movement uses one adjacent connection, may use empty routes and collect at most one good kept beside board; recruitment and ordinary activators go to bag; Deed tiles remain permanently; goods-producing Places require matching Goods Market supply.

checked_claims.source: matching-rulebook.pdf p.19
checked_claims.detail: Each point is one track step; onto/past coin reward, first onto/past Citizen reward, immediate Status changes, initial Status 1, full last round, unique station-majority Citizen, coin/goods values, (built stations + Citizens) times final Status, Development Track tie-break and shared victory all agree.

checked_claims.source: matching-rulebook.pdf pp.14,20
checked_claims.detail: Three copies of each; Pilgrimage acts during Actions; Income equals Status; Harvest food types, return to Goods Market and forced 5-coin fallback; Taxes round down goods/3; Trading Day counts built stations; Plague random bag tile to recruitable supply without track reversal, marked starter causes no loss/no redraw.

checked_claims.source: matching-rulebook.pdf p.21
checked_claims.detail: Every missing required coin costs one item of chosen mixed types: built/unbuilt station, random eligible bag Follower (redraw marked starters), legal backward Development Point, good, Place or Technology. Items removed from game; only Development Points regainable. No Market/action Follower payment allowed. Starting marked Followers remain with player.

checked_claims.topic: Finite supplies, payment order and coin shortage
checked_claims.source: matching-rulebook.pdf p.21
checked_claims.detail: Character/Technology/goods availability gates their whole producing action, Harvest/Plague can replenish, insufficient coin supply suspends coin receipt, payments use general supply and proceed clockwise where order matters.
